spec.description:
Autex Lanes Baffle Sawtooth is a dynamic acoustic wall batten system that
features an asymmetrical, directional sawtooth profile folded from 12mm Cube
polyester felt. Engineered with an acoustic air cavity behind each 300mm wide
lane, Sawtooth achieves the highest acoustic performance in the Lanes collection
with an NRC of 0.85. Its glue-free clipping system creates striking directional
light-and-shadow lines across interior walls while effectively taming
reverberation.
features:
Asymmetrical angled sawtooth profile creating
directional rhythm and shadow

Delivers the highest acoustic performance in
the Lanes range at NRC 0.85

Integrated rear air gap boosts low and mid
frequency sound absorption

Glue-free mechanical clipping system ensures fast,
clean, and precise installation

Constructed from 100% polyester fibre
containing minimum 60% to 80% recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with
AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and AS 5637.1

Modular 300mm wide sections for flexible,
scalable wall design

Moisture and mould resistant with an ASTM G21-15 Growth
Rating of 0

Available
in 2400mm and 2700mm lengths across the full Autex Cube colour palette

install:
Confirm wall surface is plumb, smooth, and
structurally sound

Mark vertical layout lines at 300mm intervals to align
sawtooth panels

Fasten horizontal mounting clips or channel system to wall
framing studs

Clip the folded Sawtooth sections onto mounting clips in
sequence

Check that the directional sawtooth angles are consistently oriented
across the entire wall

Trim height neatly with a track saw or sharp knife at
baseboard or ceiling junction
selection_checklist:
Determine wall
height to select 2400mm or 2700mm length (or custom up to 3600mm)

Calculate
required wall width in 300mm multiples (3 lanes per pack)

Verify Sawtooth
orientation and direction of incoming light to maximise 3D shadow effect
Choose colourway from Autex Cube palette

Confirm framing structure
accommodates clip fasteners
limitations:
Indoor wall installation only; not suitable for exterior
cladding or wet areas

Directional profile must be installed in a consistent
orientation across the wall

Mechanical clip installation is required; do not
glue directly flat to substrate

not_for:
Wet rooms with direct
running water
retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Lanes Baffle Sawtooth is an
asymmetrical, angled 3D acoustic batten wall system folded from 12mm Cube
polyester felt into 300mm wide modular sections. It delivers the highest sound
absorption in the Lanes collection (NRC 0.85) thanks to an integrated rear air
cavity created by its glue-free clipping system. Rated Group 1 fire compliant
under AS ISO 9705 and certified carbon neutral with over 60% recycled PET, it
provides dynamic architectural shadow play and class-leading acoustics for
commercial and institutional interiors.
